title: Add contextual anchor lifecycle and progression gate CI hook
author: Priya Menon
release_notes: Introduce a staged anchor lifecycle and progression gate CI hook to reduce noisy regressions on large prompt sets; opt-in via eval-config anchors.workflows. Improves signal-to-noise for regression alerts.
description: Motivation: Flaky or locally scoped prompt regressions generate high-noise CI alerts. This PR implements a contextual anchor lifecycle and a progression gate that moves candidate failures through staged verification before failing the main CI. Design summary: 1) Anchors are short representative prompt subsets (per-cohort) stored with a light fingerprint and baseline metrics. 2) When a CI eval sees a failure on a full prompt-set, the hook emits a candidate and triggers a staged progression: -- Stage 0: Quick smoke re-run with tighter sampling of the same seed. -- Stage 1: Anchored replay (deterministic) that replays the exact examples against the new model/variant and compares composite metrics (semantic-similarity, token-level match, and domain-specific scorer) against stored anchor baseline with configurable tolerances. -- Stage 2: Progressive escalation runs the candidate across a wider randomized cohort and collects metric distributions; failure only bubbles if composite severity > configured progression_threshold. Key properties: contextual thresholds per-cohort, time-windowed backfill (to avoid regressions from transient infra flakiness), and automatic soft-fail tagging to avoid pager storms. CI integration: new hook eval-harness/hooks/progression_gate.py registers in the CI pipeline (e2e/ci/pipelines/progression-gate.yaml) and talks to eval-metrics-service via a Prometheus-compatible adapter for retrieving historical anchor baselines. Opt-in config: anchors.workflows in eval_config.yaml; default gate is disabled for existing projects to maintain backwards compatibility. Checklist: - [x] Implementation of progression gate hook and lifecycle manager - [x] Prometheus adapter for anchor baseline lookup - [x] Deterministic anchored replay test harness - [x] Unit and integration tests - [x] Docs and examples for anchor config - [x] CI pipeline wiring and flake mitigation (retries) Commits summary: three logical commits: 1) initial progression gate prototype and lifecycle model (progression_gate.py + helpers) 2) metrics adapter + tests (prometheus_adapter.py) 3) docs, examples, CI pipeline + test fixes (docs/anchors.md, sample_anchor.yaml, pipeline yaml). Files changed (high level): eval-harness/hooks/progression_gate.py; eval-harness/lifecycle/anchor_manager.py; eval-harness/metrics/prometheus_adapter.py; eval-harness/tests/test_progression_gate.py; e2e/ci/pipelines/progression-gate.yaml; docs/anchors.md; examples/anchor_configs/sample_anchor.yaml Testing: local unit tests added to cover anchor state transitions and composite scoring; integration CI runs simulate a seeded regression and validate that only Stage 2 escalates to a fail when severity passes the threshold. Rollout plan: merged behind feature flag; enable for one service (search-rewrites) for one week as canary, monitor alert volume and false positives, then expand. Backout plan: config toggle to disable anchors.workflows; CI will revert to legacy immediate-fail behavior and a short hotfix script provided in ci/scripts/run_anchor_replay.sh. Related: ENG-2578 (anchor lifecycle), ENG-2749 (CI gating UX).

notes_for_operators: Enable anchors.workflows per-project in eval_config.yaml. Use 'anchor_manager snapshot' to create a baseline snapshot for a cohort prior to enabling. Monitor 'anchor.progression.severity' and 'anchor.progression.latency' Prometheus metrics for first 72h after enablement.
